body:
The problem actually runs a little deeper: All comment blocks directly adjacent to a code region start or end line have some sort of folding problem:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a42ea7ab-db1f-4bab-9f0a-ab1d41306612)

There are two problems with the same underlying cause here:

## The First Problem

The reported issue of comment blocks not folding is caused here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8bd9cdeea6d3ec329ca43a0da6d77e91ef9297d3/scene/gui/code_edit.cpp#L1648 The call to `is_in_comment` for the previous line (`p_line - 1`) is "mistaking" a code region tag on that line for an ordinary comment. This happens because `is_in_comment` gets its information from calling `_is_in_delimiter`: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8bd9cdeea6d3ec329ca43a0da6d77e91ef9297d3/scene/gui/code_edit.cpp#L1946-L1947 `_is_in_delimiter` is agnostic to code regions, however. All it knows is that it's supposed to look for `TYPE_COMMENT` (of the enum `DelimiterType`), so a line like `#region foo` or `#endregion` is identified as a comment. The fact that it is also a region tag isn't considered.

## The Second Problem

Code region start and end lines getting folded by comments is caused by the same basic issue as the first problem: The code that is being relied on for determining where the comment block ends is agnostic to code regions: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8bd9cdeea6d3ec329ca43a0da6d77e91ef9297d3/scene/gui/code_edit.cpp#L1701
